auth.signInHint: Use your staff email and password.
auth.contactAdmin: Contact your administrator if you can't sign in.
auth.changeHint: Your password was reset by an administrator. Choose a new password to continue.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.shellNote: The dashboard widgets arrive with the Inventory and Sales phases. The shell, navigation and session handling are live.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts. Users are deactivated, never deleted.
users.tempShownOnce: Shown once. Share it with the user; they must change it at next sign-in.
users.roleHintAdmin: Full access, including users, settings and the audit log.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company profile, logo, PDF terms and the Marla conversion.
settings.firstRunBody: The company name, logo and terms text appear on every allotment letter and payment schedule. Add them once; you can edit them here any time.
settings.name: Company name
settings.pdfTermsHint: Printed on allotment letters as plain text, in English.
settings.marlaHint: Default for every project that does not set its own conversion. 1 Marla = 225 sq ft by default.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Shown on PDFs.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Society projects and their master plans. Blocks arrive with the next setup step; plots and the map are Phase 3.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create the first one.
projects.name: Project name
projects.marlaHint: Leave blank to use the company conversion. Plot sizes are stored in Marla and never rewritten.
projects.inactiveHint: Deactivating keeps the project's history and does not touch its blocks or plots.
projects.inherited: Uses the company conversion ({{value}} sq ft per Marla)
projects.staleBody: Someone else saved a change while you were editing. Reload the project to get the latest values, then save again.
projects.masterPlanHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 25 MB. Replacing the image keeps the old file for history.
projects.aspectBody: The new image has a different aspect ratio from the current plan. Plot outlines will be stretched to fit. Continue only if the new image maps the same area.
